verdict.rationale: Evidence shows editor plugins can be built in GDScript without reloading the editor (godot-docs-4/13) and Godot's scene/node system supports live editing, implying reasonably fast iteration, but there is no direct documentation or community confirmation of hot-reloading running gameplay scripts or near-instant preview after a script change during play mode. missing for 10: explicit docs on script hot-reload during play, independent hands-on confirmation of edit-run loop speed for gameplay code, comparison benchmarks.
